zh:
從前，有|一隻|好可愛|的|小兔子，牠|有|一對|長長|的|耳朵。
每天|早上，牠|都會|去|森林|裡面|找|不同|的|小動物|一起|玩。
大家|都很|喜歡|和|小兔子|做|朋友，整個|森林|都|充滿了|笑聲。
en:
Once upon a time, there was a cute little rabbit with long ears.
Every morning, she went into the forest to play with different little animals.
Everyone loved being friends with the little rabbit, and the forest was full of laughter.

zh:
晴朗|的|早上，鴨媽媽|帶著|黃色|的|小鴨子|來到|小河邊。
小鴨子|撲通|一聲|跳進|水裡，拍拍|翅膀，學會了|游泳。
河裡|的|小魚|游過來，開心|地|和|小鴨子|一起|轉圈圈。
en:
On a sunny morning, Mother Duck took her yellow duckling to the river.
With a splash, the little duck jumped into the water, flapped his wings, and learned to swim.
Little fish swam over and happily spun in circles with the duckling.

zh:
下雨|過後，太陽公公|出來了，天空|中|出現了|一道|美麗|的|彩虹。
紅色|的|蘋果，橙色|的|橘子，黃色|的|香蕉，綠色|的|樹葉。
還有|藍色|的|天空|和|紫色|的|葡萄，世界|真是|五彩繽紛！
en:
After the rain, the sun came out and a beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky.
Red apples, orange tangerines, yellow bananas, and green leaves.
Plus the blue sky and purple grapes, the world is so colorful!

zh:
每天|晚上|睡覺前，寶寶|都會|拿起|小牙刷，擠上|香香|的|牙膏。
上|刷刷，下|刷刷，左邊|右邊|都要|刷乾淨，把|蛀牙蟲|全部|趕跑。
漱漱口，照照|鏡子，牙齒|變得|又白|又亮，像|珍珠|一樣！
en:
Every night before bed, the baby picks up a little toothbrush and squeezes sweet toothpaste.
Brush up, brush down, clean left and right, chasing all the sugar bugs away.
Rinse with water and look in the mirror, the teeth are white and shiny like pearls!

zh:
有|一天，驕傲|的|兔子|先生|和|烏龜|先生|比賽|跑步。
兔子|跑得|非常|快，他|看見|烏龜|走得|這麼|慢，就|在|大樹|下面|睡著了。
烏龜|一步|一步|地|向前|走，最後|竟然|贏得了|比賽！
en:
One day, a proud hare and a tortoise had a running race.
The hare ran very fast. Seeing the tortoise walking so slowly, he fell asleep under a big tree.
The tortoise walked forward step by step and finally won the race!

zh:
森林|裡|住著|三隻|小豬，牠們|決定|各自|蓋|一間|堅固|的|新房子。
豬大哥|用|稻草|蓋|房子，豬二哥|用|木頭|蓋|房子，只有|豬小弟|用|磚頭|慢慢|蓋。
大野狼|來了，吹倒了|稻草屋|和|木頭屋，最後|三隻|小豬|都|躲進了|安全|的|磚頭屋。
en:
Three little pigs lived in the forest, and they decided to build their own strong new houses.
The first pig built a house of straw, the second built one of wood, and only the youngest built slowly with bricks.
The big bad wolf came and blew down the straw and wood houses, so all three pigs hid safely in the brick house.

title_en: Little Bear Plants an Apple Tree
zh:
春天|到了，小熊|在|院子|裡|種下了|一顆|小小|的|蘋果|樹苗。
牠|每天|給|小樹|澆水、曬太陽，小樹苗|慢慢|長高了。
到了|秋天，樹上|結滿了|又大|又紅|的|甜蘋果，小熊|請|大家|一起|分享。
en:
Spring arrived, and Little Bear planted a tiny apple sapling in the yard.
He watered the little tree and gave it sunshine every day, and the sapling slowly grew tall.
In autumn, the tree was full of big red sweet apples, and Little Bear shared them with everyone.

zh:
秋天|森林|裡|落滿了|香脆|的|松果，小松鼠|撿了|滿滿|一籃子。
回家|的|路上，牠|遇見了|肚子餓|的|小刺蝟|和|小老鼠。
小松鼠|大方|地|把|松果|分給|大家，三個|好朋友|一起|度過了|溫暖|的|冬天。
en:
In autumn, the forest was full of crunchy pinecones, and Little Squirrel gathered a full basket.
On the way home, he met a hungry little hedgehog and a little mouse.
Little Squirrel generously shared the pinecones, and the three friends spent a warm winter together.

zh:
古時候，司馬光|和|一群|小朋友|在|花園|裡|玩|捉迷藏。
有個|小朋友|不小心|爬上|假山，掉進了|裝滿|水|的|大水缸|裡，大家|都|嚇哭了。
司馬光|非常|冷靜，他|抱起|一塊|大石頭|用力|砸破|水缸，水流|出來，小朋友|得救了。
en:
In ancient times, Sima Guang and his friends were playing hide and seek in a garden.
One child accidentally climbed a rockery and fell into a giant water vat, and everyone cried in fear.
Sima Guang stayed calm, picked up a heavy stone to break the vat, letting the water flow out and saving his friend.

zh:
漢朝|時候|有個|聰明|的|孩子|叫|孔融，他|有|五個|哥哥|和|一個|弟弟。
有|一天，家裡|買了|一籃|香甜|的|梨子，孔融|主動|挑了|一個|最小|的|梨子|留給|自己。
爸爸|問|他|為什麼，孔融|說|哥哥|年紀|大|應該|吃|大|的，弟弟|年紀|小|也要|照顧，大家|都|誇|他|懂|禮貌。
en:
During the Han Dynasty, a smart boy named Kong Rong had five older brothers and one younger brother.
One day, his family bought a basket of sweet pears, and Kong Rong picked the smallest one for himself.
When his father asked why, Kong Rong said older brothers deserve bigger ones and the younger brother needs care, earning praise for his courtesy.

title_en: Journey of a Little Water Drop
zh:
大海|裡|住著|一滴|快樂|的|小水滴，太陽公公|照得|暖洋洋，牠|變成了|輕飄飄|的|水蒸氣|飛上|天空。
在|寒冷|的|高空|裡，小水滴|和|夥伴們|聚|在|一起，變成了|潔白|的|大雲朵。
當|雲朵|越來越|重，小水滴|就|化作|雨點|落回|大地，滋潤|花草|後|又|流回了|大海。
en:
A happy little water drop lived in the ocean. Warmed by the sun, it turned into light vapor and floated up to the sky.
High up in the cold air, the water drop gathered with friends to form a fluffy white cloud.
When the cloud grew heavy, it fell back to earth as rain, watering plants before flowing back to the sea.

title_en: Why Does the Moon Change Shape
zh:
晚上|抬頭|看|天空，有時候|月亮|像|彎彎|的|小船，有時候|又|像|圓圓|的|大玉盤。
其實|月亮|本身|不會|發光，也|不會|真的|改變|形狀，它|只是|反射了|太陽|的|光芒。
隨著|月亮|繞著|地球|轉動，我們|看到|被|陽光|照亮|的|部分|不同，就|出現了|月圓|和|月缺。
en:
Looking up at the night sky, sometimes the moon looks like a curved boat, and sometimes like a round jade plate.
Actually, the moon neither shines on its own nor changes shape; it simply reflects sunlight.
As the moon orbits the Earth, we see different lit portions, creating crescent and full moons.

title_en: Little Ant Saves Food for Winter
zh:
夏天|太陽|暖洋洋，小螞蟻|每天|勤勞|地|把|麥粒|搬回家，放進|倉庫|存起來。
旁邊|的|小蚱蜢|整天|唱歌|跳舞，笑|小螞蟻|太|辛苦。
冬天|大雪|紛飛|時，小螞蟻|家裡|有|滿滿|的|食物，小蚱蜢|也|明白了|儲蓄|的|重要。
en:
In the warm summer sun, Little Ant worked hard every day carrying wheat grains home to save.
Little Grasshopper sang and danced all day, laughing at Little Ant.
When winter snow fell, Little Ant had plenty of food, and Grasshopper learned why saving matters.

zh:
豬媽媽|送給|小豬|三個|彩色|的|撲滿，上面|分別|寫著「花費」、「儲蓄」和「分享」。
每次|收到|零用錢，小豬|都會|把|硬幣|平均|放進|三個|罐子|裡。
小豬|既|買到了|心愛|的|貼紙，存下了|買|單車|的|錢，還|能|買|禮物|送給|好朋友。
en:
Mother Pig gave Little Pig three colorful jars labeled Spend, Save, and Share.
Whenever he got pocket money, Little Pig put coins into all three jars.
He bought stickers, saved for a bicycle, and even bought a gift for his best friend.

zh:
小猴子|拿著|存了|很久|的|零用錢|去|逛|熱鬧|的|森林|市集。
他|看見|會|發光|的|泡泡槍|好想|買，但|又|想起|繪畫課|需要|的|彩色|畫筆|用完了。
小猴子|想了想，決定|先|買|學習「需要」的|畫筆，把「想要」的|玩具|寫進|願望|清單|慢慢|存錢。
en:
Little Monkey took his saved pocket money to the busy forest market.
He wanted a glowing bubble gun, but remembered he needed new paintbrushes for art class.
He chose to buy the brushes he needed first, and put the toy on his wish list to save for later.

zh:
週末|早上，小熊|想|買|一本|百科全書，於是|決定|自己|動手|賺|零用錢。
他|採摘|新鮮|檸檬，洗乾淨|榨成|酸甜|的|檸檬汁，在|樹下|擺起|小水攤。
森林|裡|的|動物們|紛紛|來|買，小熊|擦擦|汗水，發現|靠|自己|勞動|賺來|的|錢|特別|珍貴。
en:
On a weekend morning, Little Bear wanted an encyclopedia and decided to earn money himself.
He picked fresh lemons, made sweet lemonade, and set up a small stand under a tree.
Forest animals came to buy drinks, and Little Bear learned how precious earned money is.

zh:
貓頭鷹|爺爺|給了|小兔|一顆|魔法|糖果，說|如果|忍住|今天|不|吃，明天|早上|就|會|變成|兩顆。
小兔|看著|香甜|的|糖果|吞了吞|口水，還是|決定|耐心|等一等。
過了|三天，一顆|糖果|真的|變成了|八顆，小兔|懂得了|耐心|等待|會|帶來|更大|的|收穫。
en:
Grandpa Owl gave Little Rabbit a magic candy, saying if she waited until tomorrow, it would become two.
Little Rabbit swallowed hard looking at the sweet treat, but decided to be patient.
After three days, one candy turned into eight, teaching her that patience brings bigger rewards.

zh:
小松鼠|開了|一間|小小|裁縫店，但|每個月|月底|總是|不清楚|錢|花到|哪裡|去了。
後來|他|準備了|一本|記帳本，把|每一筆|收入|和|買|紐扣、花邊|的|支出|都|記下來。
看清|花費|後，小松鼠|減少了|不必要|的|浪費，很快|就|存夠|錢|買了|新|縫紉機。
en:
Little Squirrel opened a tiny tailor shop, but never knew where his money went each month.
He started writing down every coin earned and spent on buttons and ribbons in a ledger.
By tracking his spending, he cut waste and soon saved enough for a new sewing machine.

title_en: Red Light Stop, Green Light Go
zh:
馬路|上|車子|多，過|馬路|時|要|牽好|爸爸|媽媽|的|手。
看見|紅燈|亮起來，我們|停下|腳步|耐心|等一等。
等到|綠燈|亮起來，先|看看|左邊|和|右邊，再|安全|走過|斑馬線。
en:
There are many cars on the road, so hold Mom or Dad's hand when crossing.
When the red light shines, we stop our feet and wait patiently.
When the green light turns on, look left and right, then walk safely across the zebra crossing.

zh:
心裡|住著|情緒|小怪獸，開心|時候|是|溫暖|的|黃色。
積木|倒了|好|生氣，小怪獸|就|變成了|噴火|的|紅色。
慢慢|吸氣、吐氣|三秒鐘，小怪獸|又|變回|平靜|快樂|的|綠色。
en:
A little emotion monster lives inside our heart, turning warm yellow when we are happy.
When blocks fall down and we feel mad, the monster turns fiery red.
Breathe in and out slowly for three seconds, and the monster turns back into calm, happy green.

zh:
週末|商場|人|好多，小熊|看|玩具|看得|太|入迷，一|轉身|找不到|媽媽|了。
小熊|記住|安全|口訣，不|亂跑、不|跟|陌生人|走，留|在|原地|等一等。
他|找到|穿|制服|的|服務員|阿姨|幫忙|廣播，很快|就|回到|媽媽|懷抱。
en:
The mall was crowded on the weekend, and Little Bear looked at toys until he lost sight of Mom.
He remembered the safety rule: stay put and never follow strangers.
He asked a uniformed staff member to make an announcement and was soon back in Mom's arms.

zh:
天氣|晴朗|的|下午，哥哥|帶著|妹妹|坐上|綠白|相間|的|天星|小輪。
渡輪|鳴起|汽笛|聲，海風|輕輕|吹過|臉龐，海鷗|在|藍天|下|自由|飛翔。
看著|兩岸|高高|的|大廈|和|古老|鐘樓，妹妹|開心地|拍手|歡呼。
en:
On a sunny afternoon, Brother took Sister onto the green-and-white Star Ferry.
The ferry blew its horn, sea breeze brushed their faces, and seagulls flew under the blue sky.
Looking at the tall skyscrapers and historic clock tower, Sister clapped her hands in joy.

zh:
農曆|五月|初五|是|端午節，海邊|傳來|陣陣|響亮|的|鑼鼓聲。
一艘艘|彩繪|龍舟|像|離弦|的|箭，選手們|喊著|口號|齊心|向前|划。
岸邊|的|觀眾|一邊|吃著|香噴噴|的|糉子，一邊|大聲|加油，展現了|團結|合作|的|力量。
en:
The fifth day of the fifth lunar month is the Dragon Boat Festival, filled with loud drums by the sea.
Painted dragon boats dart like arrows as paddlers row together in unison.
Spectators eat fragrant rice dumplings and cheer loudly, celebrating the power of teamwork.

zh:
星期天|早上，全家人|一起|走進|熱鬧|的|港式|茶餐廳|吃|早餐。
剛|出爐|的|菠蘿油|外皮|金黃|酥脆，配上|熱騰騰|的|火腿|通心粉，香氣|撲鼻。
爸爸|提醒|大家|按|食量|點餐，把|盤子|裡|的|食物|吃光光，做|個|珍惜|糧食|的|好孩子。
en:
On Sunday morning, the whole family visited a lively Hong Kong cafe for breakfast.
Freshly baked pineapple buns with crispy golden crusts and hot macaroni soup smelled delicious.
Dad reminded everyone to order just enough and finish their plates to avoid wasting food.

title_en: Little Crow's New Way to Drink
zh:
天氣|好熱，小烏鴉|找到|一個|高高|的|水瓶，可是|水面|太低|喝不到。
旁邊|只有|幾顆|小石子，一顆顆|放進去|實在|太慢|了。
小烏鴉|動動|腦筋，找來|一根|空心|蘆葦管|當|吸管，輕輕鬆鬆|就|喝到了|清涼|的|水。
en:
It was a hot day, and Little Crow found a tall bottle, but the water was too low to reach.
There were only a few pebbles nearby, and dropping them one by one was too slow.
Little Crow thought smartly and used a hollow reed as a straw to drink the cool water easily.

zh:
房間|裡|積木、繪本|和|小汽車|散落|一地，看起來|好亂|呀。
媽媽|教|樂樂|使用|分類|魔法，先|把|相同|種類|的|玩具|放在|一起。
積木|回|藍色|盒子，圖書|排上|書架，不到|五分鐘，房間|就|變得|整整齊齊。
en:
Blocks, picture books, and toy cars were scattered all over the floor in a big mess.
Mom taught Leo the magic of sorting by grouping the same kinds of toys together first.
Blocks went into the blue box and books onto the shelf, making the room tidy in five minutes.

zh:
小熊|畫畫|時|總想|看|動畫片，畫了|好久|還|沒|塗完|顏色。
爸爸|拿出|小沙漏，約定|先|專心|畫|二十分鐘，再|開心|休息|五分鐘。
有了|明確|的|小目標，小熊|像|小火箭|一樣|專注，很快|就|畫出了|漂亮|的|彩虹。
en:
Little Bear kept wanting to watch cartoons while drawing and barely finished coloring.
Dad set a small timer for twenty minutes of pure focus followed by a five-minute break.
With a clear short goal, Little Bear focused like a rocket and soon finished a bright rainbow.

zh:
古時候|有人|送來|一頭|大象，大家|都|發愁|沒有|這麼大|的|秤。
聰明|的|小曹沖|把|大象|牽上|大船，在|船身|水面|畫下|一條|記號線。
接著|把|大象|牽下船，改裝|石頭|直到|船|沉到|記號線，稱出|石頭|重量|就|知道|大象|多重|了。
en:
Long ago, someone brought a huge elephant, and everyone wondered how to weigh it without a giant scale.
Clever young Cao Chong led the elephant onto a boat and marked the waterline on the hull.
After leading the elephant off, he loaded stones until the boat reached the mark, weighing the stones to find the answer.

title_zh: 森林|接力賽|的|排兵布陣
title_en: Smart Teamwork in the Forest Relay
zh:
森林|運動會|要|舉行|水陸空|接力賽，小動物們|一起|商量|致勝|策略。
小兔子|在|草地|跑得|最快|負責|第一棒，小猴子|爬樹|摘果|負責|第二棒。
最後|小烏龜|穩穩|游過|小河|衝過|終點，大家|發揮|各自|長處|贏得了|金牌。
en:
For the forest relay race across land, trees, and water, the animals planned a winning strategy.
Fast Rabbit ran the grassy first leg, and agile Monkey climbed the trees for the second leg.
Finally, steady Turtle swam across the river to the finish line, winning gold through smart teamwork.

zh:
廚房|盤子|裡|的|曲奇|餅乾|不見了，偵探|小狐狸|決定|用|排除法|找|線索。
小鳥|整天|都在|樹枝|上|唱歌，小魚|離不開|水缸，首先|排除|牠們。
接著|順著|地板|上|小小|的|麵粉|腳印，小狐狸|在|沙發|後面|找到了|偷吃|餅乾|的|小老鼠。
en:
Cookies vanished from the kitchen plate, so Detective Fox used elimination to solve the mystery.
Little Bird sang in the tree all day and Little Fish stayed in the bowl, so both were ruled out first.
Following tiny flour footprints across the floor, Fox found Little Mouse nibbling cookies behind the sofa.
